what: A 15px square cursor with only four corners follows the mouse each frame, closing 15% of the distance. Over links and buttons it morphs to that box’s size in .4s and wraps it. A sticky cell is wrapped with +8px around it, the corners grow to 10% of the shorter side (min 8px), and the cursor stays on that cell even when the mouse leaves
ease: Follow on every frame .15 · size and corner power3.out .4s

options.pad: Margin around the stuck cell (px), default 8
options.targets: Selector for elements to wrap, default a, button, [role=button], [data-fx-part=stick]
options.grow: Width added around the link or button when wrapping (px, both sides combined), default 0 — 3d-discovery is 20
options.idle: With hide, it stays hidden at 0 scale normally, grows over dur with power3.out only when wrapping, and shrinks again on leaving. The system cursor is left as is
options.skip: Targets inside this selector are not wrapped (comma-separated) — in 3d-discovery these are the header menu and tile links (.site-head, .dd-tile--link)

from.where: shared.js cursor (.t-cursor) — project cell (data-cursor=sticky) a small corner square that stays pinned
shared.js corner cursor — follow: .18; size: 16; grow: 20; idle: hide; skip: header · cell links

note: Wraps only targets inside the attached element (the whole page if body). On touch devices and with reduced motion it does not attach and the default cursor stays. Disabled (aria-disabled=true) targets are not wrapped. The squares move in gsap.ticker — they must settle after the wrap tween is drawn so they grow in .4s like the original
